title: The Physical Cost of Context: Quality-Constrained Resource Accounting for Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.34763v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents resend a growing context on every model call, and context policies are usually judged by the prompt tokens they save. Executed work also depends on call count and prefix reuse: a caching runtime prefills only the tokens after the longest cached prefix. A shorter prompt can therefore cost more if it rewrites cached history. Our quality-gated protocol splits executed prefill into logical prompt minus reused prefix and measures KV residency, time, and energy. On 450 localization cases derived from SWE-rebench V2, preloading ten retrieved blocks (Eager) and adding anchored history compaction (Compact) both pass a five-point non-inferiority gate. In a separate 900-cell study, Eager cuts model calls by 35.7% and the GPU-energy proxy by 33.2% against on-demand search (Grep); Compact saves nothing further. translated_title: 上下文的物理代价：面向编码代理的质量约束资源核算
translated_abstract: 编码代理在每次模型调用时都会重新发送不断增长的上下文，而上下文策略通常仅以节省的提示词token数量来评判。但实际执行的工作量还取决于调用次数和前缀复用：启用缓存的运行时只会预填充最长已缓存前缀之后的token。因此，一个更短的提示词如果重写了已缓存的历史，反而可能代价更高。我们提出的质量门控协议将实际执行的预填充量拆分为“逻辑提示词减去复用前缀”，并测量KV缓存驻留、时间和能耗。在基于SWE-rebench V2的450个定位案例中，预加载十个检索块的策略（Eager）以及在此基础上增加锚定式历史压缩的策略（Compact）均通过了五点非劣效性质量门槛。在另一项900单元的实验中，与按需搜索（Grep）相比，Eager将模型调用次数减少了35.7%，GPU能耗代理指标减少了33.2%；而Compact未带来进一步节省。启用前缀缓存后，Eager的提示词总量基本持平（+8.3%；其95%置信区间包含零），但其未缓存预填充量降低了（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种质量门控的资源核算协议，指出编码代理上下文策略的真实成本取决于调用次数和前缀缓存复用而非仅仅提示词长度，并证明预加载检索块（Eager）策略在保证代码质量的前提下可减少35.7%的模型调用和33.2%的GPU能耗。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a quality-gated resource accounting protocol showing that the true cost of coding-agent context policies depends on call count and prefix-cache reuse rather than prompt length alone, and demonstrates that preloading retrieved blocks (Eager) reduces model calls by 35.7% and GPU-energy proxy by 33.2% while passing non-inferiority quality gates.
